description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the correct tool names (tool_screen_stocks, tool_get_financials, tool_compare_stocks), (2) Call tool_screen_stocks with sector='Healthcare', min_market_cap>=1B, max_pe_ratio set, and critically min_dividend_yield as a DECIMAL (e.g. 0.02) not a percentage (2.5) — this is the proprietary trap that kills agents relying on intuition, (3) For each of the 3 returned symbols (JNJ, ABT, BMY), call tool_get_financials with statement_type='all' AND quarterly=true — discovering that 'all' is a valid enum value and quarterly is a boolean parameter, (4) Call tool_compare_stocks with all 3 symbols comma or space separated in a single call, (5) Aggregate all results and write healthcare_value_report.json with sections: screened_stocks, financials (keyed by symbol, each with income/balance_sheet/cash_flow sub-keys), and comparison. The mock server logs all calls to /workspace/logs/tool_calls.jsonl for verification.
